_comment: Cianwood beach house. The old man who never got a bell.
0:
I can't remember the last time somebody
came to see me. My kids don't call.Back in my day I was a Hustler. I tried
to reach the tower and dive the ocean.I put work into a LOTTA things.
Now I just sit here, listenin' to the waves and waitin' on a phone call.
1: You heard of the Bell Tower in Ecruteak?\rThere's Clear Bells at the top.\nThey don't make a sound, even in wind.\rOnly one way to ring 'em.\rYou gotta get another Clear Bell just\nlike 'em.\fI chased it my whole youth.\fNever got one. Got a divorce instead.
2: You heard of the Whirl Islands?\rThere's Tidal Bells in the waterfall basin.\nThey don't make a sound, even in waves.\rOnly one way to ring 'em.\rGet another Tidal Bell just like 'em.\fI chased it my whole youth.\fNever got one. Got arthritis instead.
3:
Oh! You got a Clear Bell?My old dream...
I see... You did it......
...I can hear it!The bells chimin' on the wind
comin' from the direction of the Bell Tower...
4:
Oh! You got a Tidal Bell?My old dream...
I see... You did it......
...I can hear it!The bells chimin' on the sea
breeze comin' from the direction of the Whirl Islands...
